annotations.title: Roles from a past Jobs Brief edition

description: Hand-picked senior cloud, platform, DevOps, SRE and AI-infrastructure roles from a past Jobs Brief edition: remote across the EU ('remote-eu') or in Poland ('poland'), at mid, senior or manager level. Each role has its location, contract form where stated, core stack, a one-line summary of the work, the published salary when there is one, and a link to the company's own posting. All filters are optional and combine.

query.description: Free text matched against title, company and summary, e.g. 'observability' or 'GPU'.

section.description: remote-eu: remote roles open across the EU. poland: roles based in Poland.

stack.description: A technology to match in the role's stack, e.g. kubernetes, terraform, aws, gcp.
